pipeline.input: [E] P1 c3=1/(8pi), P2 g_car=5 and the compiler rank split.
pipeline.operation: [E] Complete D5+A3 by the forced order-four glue.
pipeline.output: [E] The E8 lattice with mu4 glue.

pipeline.input: [E] E8 and its even unimodular rank-eight quadratic form.
pipeline.operation: [E] Count shells and form the lattice theta series.
pipeline.output: [E] theta_E8=E4 and N(n)=240 sigma_3(n); [I] weight 4 follows universally from rank 8, while TFPT selects E8.
pipeline.scope: universal lattice mathematics after a TFPT-specific lattice choice

pipeline.input: [E] The mu4-marked Gaussian E8 glue classes.
pipeline.operation: [E] Apply the nontrivial mod-4 sign and count Gaussian norms.
pipeline.output: [E] theta_3^2=r_2 and the signed glue census c=theta_3^2 theta_4^6=Theta_0-Theta_2, carrying chi_-4; [I] signed quadratic counting is universal, but the selected mu4 mark is TFPT-specific.
pipeline.scope: universal theta construction on a TFPT-specific marked module

pipeline.input: [E] The unmarked and character-marked theta coefficients.
pipeline.operation: [E] Take Dirichlet series and Euler-factor decompositions.
pipeline.output: [E] 240 zeta(s)zeta(s-3), chi_-4/Gaussian splitting data, and D_chi=L(s,chi)L(s-3,chi) on the certified coefficient window.
pipeline.scope: universal multiplicativity/Euler products; TFPT selects the character channels

pipeline.input: [E] Four marked census theta series on E8.
pipeline.operation: [E] Enumerate Kneser p-neighbours and decompose the marked neighbour sum.
pipeline.output: [E] nu_p=a(p)Id+b(p)T_p, sigma_3(p)=1+p^3 and cusp coefficients a_p=b-sigma_3(p).
pipeline.scope: Kneser/Hecke mathematics is universal; the four glue channels and recovered cusp system are TFPT-specific

pipeline.output: [E] Five E4 oldforms at levels 1,2,4,8,16 and two f8 oldforms at levels 8,16, with f8=eta(2tau)^4 eta(4tau)^4.
pipeline.scope: oldform theory is universal; this level pattern is selected by the mu4/2-adic glue census

pipeline.operation: [E] Apply the t=2 Shimura lift and T(p^2).
pipeline.output: [E] A unique g with Sh(g)=-8f8, the f8 Hecke eigenvalues and U4(g)=0; level 32=4*8 is the half-integral Kohnen scope fence, not another oldform level.
pipeline.scope: Shimura theory is universal; uniqueness inside this compiler monoid is TFPT-specific

pipeline.input: [E] Signed lattice periods and the f8 spectral projector.
pipeline.operation: [E] Match geometric and spectral relative traces.
pipeline.output: [E] lambda_geom=lambda_Eis+a_p^2 on the certified primes; [N] Waldspurger ratios for L(f8 tensor chi_d,2).
pipeline.scope: classical RTF/Waldspurger framework with a TFPT-specific finite matching

primes_entry_points.point: [E] The first literal prime-indexed operation is Kneser p-neighbour geometry; its input is a prime p because Hecke correspondences are indexed by primes.
[I] Before Kneser adjacency, primes are only implicit in multiplicativity/Euler products of theta-series coefficients, not dynamically generated.
[E] TFPT-specific arithmetic beyond zeta(s)zeta(s-3) includes chi_-4 splitting and the GL(2) newform f8; no proved bridge transports these to new GL(1)/xi zero information.
[E] Firewall checks establish absence of zero/prime-table oracle identifiers in particular constructions; they do not prove that a derived object generates primes.

encoded_quantities.encoding: [E] Static E8 shell census. For prime p, p is detected by N(p)=240(1+p^3); [I] the converse follows from sigma_3(n)>1+n^3 for composite n.
encoded_quantities.zero_content: [E] Its L-function is exactly 240 zeta(s)zeta(s-3), with nontrivial zeros {rho} union {rho+3}; the corpus proves this bridge is RH-neutral.

encoded_quantities.encoding: [E] Gaussian norm representations and p=1 mod 4 splitting through chi_-4; the signed glue series is c=theta_3^2 theta_4^6.
encoded_quantities.zero_content: [I] Its Euler product carries the corresponding Dirichlet L-function; no independent zero-location information is produced.

encoded_quantities.sequence: marked E8 census coefficients c(n) and a_p=-c(p)/8
encoded_quantities.encoding: [E] The cusp channel f8 and its Hecke eigenvalues.
encoded_quantities.zero_content: [E] This is a GL(2) L-function, not zeta's GL(1) problem; the weight-4 to GL(1) bridge is open.

encoded_quantities.sequence: Lambda(n) prime-power comb used by the Weil windows
encoded_quantities.encoding: [E] The explicit-formula event list at positions log(p^k), with von Mangoldt weights.
encoded_quantities.zero_content: [E] It is an input side of the classical explicit formula, not an output of TFPT dynamics.

encoded_quantities.encoding: [E] Character-twisted divisor sums with D_chi=L(s,chi)L(s-3,chi) through n=200 in v1018.
encoded_quantities.zero_content: [E] The paper states this maps GRH for those Dirichlet functions onto itself.

dynamical_inventory.name: finite E8/Coxeter/mu4 clocks
dynamical_inventory.result: [E] They cannot realize more than one prime period because all periods are commensurable, whereas log p are Q-linearly independent.

dynamical_inventory.name: ordered E8 event jumps
dynamical_inventory.result: [N] Order is decorative without free evolution; free evolution makes order visible but not prime-specific.

dynamical_inventory.name: relay lead law
dynamical_inventory.result: [N] Uses supplied prime-power events; r635 is LEAD_PARTIAL and r636 LEAD_LAW_NULL, so the proposed lead law is catalogued as killed rather than a generator.

dynamical_inventory.name: clock torsion / ECM
dynamical_inventory.result: [N] Reproduces known constant-factor ECM torsion gains; no new exponent and no prime generator.

dynamical_inventory.name: seam geodesic
dynamical_inventory.result: [N] Reduces to SQUFOF/class-group period finding on a supplied composite N; it factors, but does not generate the prime event log.

dynamical_inventory.name: arch rate, Gate 0, extraction joint and L2 cascade
dynamical_inventory.result: [E/I] These are transport, rate, or positivity-reduction structures over the already assembled explicit-formula comb; none is proved to emit log(p^k) autonomously.

never_asked.absence_evidence: The only explicit dynamical theorem is negative for finite clocks (tfpt_prime_front.tex:921-951); support_relay_census_probe.py:3-7 declares prime-power events as its census.

never_asked.question: [I] Is there a formal information-equivalence theorem for the mu4 census and its known Euler products?
never_asked.absence_evidence: The paper proves RH-neutrality only for the E8 Eisenstein and character-product bridges (tfpt_prime_front.tex:851-890), not a general information-theoretic theorem.

never_asked.question: [I] What information does the mu4 mark retain beyond chi_-4 and the selected f8 isotype?
never_asked.absence_evidence: The mechanism account stops at character, theta and Hecke outputs (tfpt_prime_front.tex:637-693).

never_asked.absence_evidence: v535 proves the 5+2 oldform decomposition (verification/v535_hecke_from_geometry.py:25-29); v537 proves uniqueness only in the 70-object compiler monoid (verification/v537_halfintegral_bridge.py:7-16).

never_asked.absence_evidence: rg count for g_car is zero in v535 and v536; the five E4 copies arise from divisors 1,2,4,8,16 (verification/v535_hecke_from_geometry.py:733-795), so identifying that five with g_car would be numerology without a bridge.

never_asked.absence_evidence: The weight-4 to GL(1) bridge remains open (verification/v535_hecke_from_geometry.py:41-48).

positivity_sources.name: Waldspurger/Kohnen-Zagier square b(d)^2
positivity_sources.transport_blocker: [E/I] It applies to central twists of the GL(2) cusp form f8; the corpus has only numerical constancy and lacks the open weight-4/GL(2) to GL(1) Weil transport. It does not cover the E4 Eisenstein part.

positivity_sources.name: Siegel-Weil theta-integral / positive linear carrier
positivity_sources.transport_blocker: [E] The carrier gives a plus sum of shifted zeta forms, but only in the Euler region and off the zeta critical line; lambda* remains open.

positivity_sources.name: Rankin-Selberg/Cauchy-Littlewood norm-square normalization
positivity_sources.transport_blocker: [E] Even-k deletion and square-plane doubling create the wrong sign or a shifted two-copy problem; no direct GL(1) critical-line inequality results.

positivity_sources.name: GNS finite-family positivity
positivity_sources.transport_blocker: [E] Its core relation has the wrong doubling sign and a non-automorphic correction; dense positivity is open.

positivity_sources.name: Suzuki/W1 and finite L* positivity
positivity_sources.transport_blocker: [E] W1 identifies the same explicit-formula quadratic form; L* is a canonical equivalent scalar, so this is a dictionary rather than an independent source.

story.proved: [E] The TFPT-selected E8 lattice has theta E4, shell counts 240 sigma_3, a mu4/chi_-4 Gaussian channel, Kneser-Hecke operators, a seven-dimensional 2-adic oldform decomposition, and a unique compiler half-integral preimage of f8 on the certified scope. The E8 Eisenstein bridge is exactly zeta(s)zeta(s-3) and is proved RH-neutral. Finite TFPT clocks cannot realize the incommensurable prime periods log p.
story.numerical: [N] Finite prime-splitting censuses, Waldspurger-ratio constancy, per-window positivity, relay leads, matched Dirichlet worlds, ECM clock gains and seam-geodesic factoring behavior are measured or certified only on declared finite surfaces.
story.asserted: [P] The corpus's 'primes as shadow/checksum/event log' language interprets static shell, character and Hecke data as a record of arithmetic consistency. It is not a theorem that TFPT dynamics generates primes, their order, or new zero information.
story.missing: [I] A precise event-log mechanism needs either an autonomous non-periodic TFPT flow with primitive periods log p and amplitudes log p, derived without a prime oracle, or a theorem that the compiler's finite/algebraic data can only re-encode known Euler products. Cheapest decisive test: freeze a source-only state-transition rule from P1/P2/E8/mu4, generate its first events before comparison, and require exact support-and-weight recovery on held-out prime powers plus scrambled/Epstein controls; any use of sieving, Lambda, primality, or fitted event locations fails the firewall.
